answer: A bonded staking mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock tokens in escrow before transacting. Each identity activates only upon registering a verifiable balance delta, imposing the scarce cost of illiquid capital per node. Whether an adversary surveys a terrace or tracks falcon migration, spawning fake agents requires linear financial commitment. However, this creates severe barriers for underfunded participants and exposes deposits to token volatility.
